falsas.descricao: Sends browser requests through XMLHttpRequest, adding XSRF cookie headers and a Firefox status-zero fallback that settles navigation-canceled requests as empty successes.
falsas.afirmacao: The sentence says the Firefox status-zero fallback settles navigation-canceled requests as empty successes. The code does the opposite: when request.status is 0 and the URL is not file:, onloadend rejects with an AxiosError ECONNABORTED ('Request aborted'). Only file: URLs with status 0 proceed to settle() as a success.
falsas.correcao: Sends browser requests through XMLHttpRequest, adds XSRF cookie headers, and rejects status-zero loads with ECONNABORTED unless the URL uses the file: scheme.

falsas.descricao: Walks params with an explicit stack to reject circular references before merging, so a self-referencing params object fails with ERR_BAD_OPTION_VALUE instead of exhausting the call stack.
falsas.afirmacao: The sentence says the acyclic check runs before merging, but mergeParams calls assertParamsAcyclic only after it has built the copied result, so the check runs after the copy step.
falsas.correcao: Walks params with an explicit stack to reject circular references after mergeParams copies them, throwing ERR_BAD_OPTION_VALUE rather than recursing.

falsas.descricao: Runs request transforms, selects the adapter, checks cancellation and times adapter execution with a monotonic clock, so each request reports elapsed time that wall-clock jumps cannot skew.
falsas.afirmacao: The sentence claims a monotonic clock always times the adapter, but resolveClock falls back to Date.now (a wall clock) when performance.now is unavailable, so skew is not prevented in that case.
falsas.correcao: Times adapter execution with performance.now() when available, falling back to Date.now() and clamping negative elapsed time to zero.
